evidence.why: Complete callback, helper arguments and strict comparison.
Origin lookup branches include parented-joint matrix setup.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact predicate while distinguishing local writes from delegated matrix setup.
facts.value: With valid position and JObj inputs, obtains the JObj origin through lb_8000B1CC and returns the strict floating-point comparison position->y + 1.0F > origin.y. Equality and unordered comparisons return false. The integer argument is unused. The callback makes no direct persistent writes, but the delegated origin lookup calls HSD_JObjSetupMatrix for a parented joint, so the complete call must not be described as guaranteed free of object-state updates.

facts.value: Parameterless stage-start lifecycle callback with signature void (void). It returns no value and returns control normally after calling grZakoGenerator_801CAE04(NULL).
